description: Follows Enuma Elish from the conflict of divine generations to Marduk’s bargain for supremacy, victory over Tiamat, organization of the heavens and creation of humanity. Explains how the Tablet of Destinies, the founding of Babylon’s sanctuary, fifty names and New Year ritual connect cosmology to kingship, and compares the epic with Atrahasis and Genesis without assuming direct borrowing.
